budget_items.topic: Windows-based front end controllers replacement, PS
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Replacement of Windows-based front end controllers at PS is listed as first priority at $14,000; the bulk of the cost is programming.
Phase I in FY15 at Turkey Hill Middle School is estimated at $138,000 to remove ceilings and abate friable asbestos on the first floor; Phase II in FY 16 would go to the second floor.
